sec.title: September 4 Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 755)
sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on **September 4** across three years of Jane Morgan's beloved Pacific Coast daytime drama *Aunt Mary* for Albers Milling and Safeway (1945, 1946, 1947), Alan Young grappling with post-war civilian life on *The Alan Young Show* for Sal Hepatica, Westinghouse science educator Dr. Phillips Thomas exploring entomology on *Adventures in Research*, and traditional western hoedowns on *Chuck Wagon Jamboree*, Jane Morgan (1945, 1946, 1947), Alan Young (1945), Dr. Phillips Thomas (1945), and Western Rangers (1945–1948):
